title: Rav Chama bar Ada, Emissary of Zion
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Beitzah 25b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.25b.12-13) Rav Nachman said to him: “When you go up there, go around by the Ladder of Tyre and go to Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi.” While he was on his way, Rabbi Yaakov bar Idi died; when he went up, he found Rabbi Zerika, etc. ([Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Beitzah.25b.12.2) explains that he regularly went up to Jerusalem, and therefore he was called Emissary of Zion.)[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Gemara, Rav Nachman sends Chama to Rabbi Yaakov with a question about being transported in a chair. After Rabbi Yaakov dies, Chama asks Rabbi Zerika, who gives Rabbi Ami’s ruling. Hyman stops at the encounter. Rashi explains the title by Chama’s frequent journeys to Jerusalem.
